functions.name: ReshapeWindow
functions.docs: Native windows should implement ReshapeWindow by changing the platform-specific window to be located at (X,Y) and be the dimensions Width x Height.

functions.name: GetFullScreenInfo
functions.docs: Returns the rectangle of the screen the window is associated with

functions.name: MoveWindowTo
functions.docs: Native windows should implement MoveWindowTo by relocating the platform-specific window to (X,Y).

functions.name: BringToFront
functions.docs: Native windows should implement BringToFront by making this window the top-most window (i.e. focused).

functions.name: HACK_ForceToFront
functions.docs: @hack Force a window to front even if a different application is in front.

functions.name: Destroy
functions.docs: Native windows should implement this function by asking the OS to destroy OS-specific resource associated with the window (e.g. Win32 window handle)

functions.name: Minimize
functions.docs: Native window should implement this function by performing the equivalent of the Win32 minimize-to-taskbar operation

functions.name: Maximize
functions.docs: Native window should implement this function by performing the equivalent of the Win32 maximize operation

functions.name: Restore
functions.docs: Native window should implement this function by performing the equivalent of the Win32 restore operation

functions.name: Show
functions.docs: Native window should make itself visible

functions.name: Hide
functions.docs: Native window should hide itself

functions.name: SetWindowMode
functions.docs: Toggle native window between fullscreen and normal mode

functions.name: GetWindowMode
functions.docs: @return true if the native window is currently in fullscreen mode, false otherwise

functions.name: IsMaximized
functions.docs: @return true if the native window is maximized, false otherwise

functions.name: IsMinimized
functions.docs: @return true if the native window is minimized, false otherwise

functions.name: IsVisible
functions.docs: @return true if the native window is visible, false otherwise

functions.name: GetRestoredDimensions
SetWindowFocus
functions.docs:
Native windows should implement SetWindowFocus to let the OS know that a window has taken focus.
Slate handles focus on a per widget basis internally but the OS still needs to know what window has focus for proper message routing

functions.name: SetOpacity
functions.docs:
Sets the opacity of this window
@param	InOpacity	The new window opacity represented as a floating point scalar

functions.name: Enable
functions.docs:
Enables or disables the window.  If disabled the window receives no input
@param bEnable	true to enable the window, false to disable it.

functions.name: IsPointInWindow
functions.docs: @return true if native window exists underneath the coordinates

functions.name: GetWindowBorderSize
functions.docs: Gets OS specific window border size. This is necessary because Win32 does not give control over this size.

functions.name: GetWindowTitleBarSize
functions.docs: Gets OS specific window title bar size

functions.name: GetOSWindowHandle
functions.docs: Gets the OS Window handle in the form of a void pointer for other API's

functions.name: IsForegroundWindow
functions.docs: @return true if the window is in the foreground

functions.name: IsFullscreenSupported
functions.docs: @return true if the window is in the foreground

functions.name: SetText
functions.docs:
Sets the window text - usually the title but can also be text content for things like controls
@param Text	The window's title or content text

functions.name: GetDefinition
functions.docs: @return	The definition describing properties of the window

functions.name: IsDefinitionValid
functions.docs: @return	Returns true if the window definition is valid

functions.name: AdjustCachedSize
functions.docs: @return	Gives the native window a chance to adjust our stored window size before we cache it off

functions.name: GetDPIScaleFactor
functions.docs:
@return ratio of pixels to SlateUnits in this window.
E.g. DPIScale of 2.0 means there is a 2x2 pixel square for every 1x1 SlateUnit.

functions.name: SetDPIScaleFactor
functions.docs: sets a new DPI scale factor

functions.name: IsManualManageDPIChanges
functions.docs: determines whether or not this window does its own DPI management

functions.name: SetManualManageDPIChanges
functions.docs: call with a true argument if this window need to do its custom size management in response to DPI variations

functions.name: DrawAttention
functions.docs:
Attempts to draw the user's attention to this window in whatever way is
appropriate for the platform if this window is not the current active
window.
@param Parameters The parameters for drawing attention. Depending on
the platform, not all parameters may be supported.

functions.name: SetNativeWindowButtonsVisibility
functions.docs: Shows or hides native window buttons on platforms that use them
